alertbox: Pops up for follows, subs, cheers and raids.
eventlist: Lists the latest events as they arrive.
goal: Tracks a follower, sub or bits target.
label: Prints one stat, like your latest follower.
chatbox: Shows live chat with badges and emotes.
emotewall: Flies chat emotes across the screen.
timer: Counts down or up to a set time.
credits: Scrolls everyone who supported the stream.
text: A fixed line of text in your font.
